mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT_WS(' ', sub_uoms.value, '(', sub_uoms_to.abbr, ')')) FROM `uom_conversions` AS sub_uoms LEFT JOIN uoms AS sub_uoms_to ON sub_uoms_to.id = sub_uoms.to_uom_id WHERE sub_uoms.is_active = 1 AND sub_uoms.from_uom_id IN (SELECT from_uom_id FROM uom_conversions WHERE id = #{id})
